messages.subject: Laser Range Finders, any recommendations?
parts:
I am seeking advice on brands of laser range finders that have been
successful (or disastrous) in bird surveys. I have never used laser range
finders but plan to use them in an alpine environment at distances of
perhaps 100m, plus. I would appreciate any feedback on your experience with
different makes and models.
Thanks,
Pete
